newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ANZ job ads for December due on Monday.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ANZ job ads for December due on Monday.

text.p: The Australia and New Zealand Banking Group will release its closely-watched monthly job advertisement series at 11.30 a.m. (0030 GMT) on Monday, ANZ chief economist Saul Eslake said.
The series release date normally falls in the same week as the Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS) labour force data, which is usually released on the second Thursday of each month.
This month, the ABS data is due on January 16, the third Thursday of the month. However, Eslake said the ANZ series for December would not be delayed.
